stop_film_source: DuPont Kapton general specifications: 300HN nominal 76.2 µm, specified thickness range 72.4–80 µm
stop_adhesive_scope: Illustrative ±10 µm bonded-adhesive scenarios; not a 3M thickness or compressed-bond guarantee
contact_signal_scope: A five-resolution-step planning screen at 0.2 N, not a noise bound, contact threshold, accuracy claim or probability guarantee
limits: Uniform rigid spreader and independent incompressible neo-Hookean posts only.
The cover contributes an illustrative parallel linear stiffness; actual cured-cover response and hysteresis are unmeasured.
The adhesive scenarios expose stop-height sensitivity; actual films and cured bonds must be measured.
Finite plate bending, edge/nail-tip contact, shear, friction, creep, thermal drift and loaded TPU motion are not solved.
A build may be geometrically reproducible while failing these planning scenarios or the required physical tests.
